title: InstaKeystrokes
description: A clean and customizable keystrokes HUD mod for Fabric 1.21.4 with draggable UI, color customization, and a modern design.
body:
# InstaKeystrokes

InstaKeystrokes is a clean and customizable keystrokes HUD mod for Minecraft Fabric 1.21.4.

## Features
- WASD display
- LMB and RMB display
- Spacebar display
- Smooth draggable HUD
- Adjustable HUD scale
- Multiple color modes
- Toggleable HUD
- Modern transparent design
- Lightweight and optimized

## Controls
- Open config GUI with your configured keybind
- Drag the HUD anywhere on screen
- Change colors and scale directly in-game

## Supported Version
- Fabric 1.21.4

Perfect for:
- PvP players
- Crystal PvP
- Bedwars
- Practice servers
- Content creators

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader
2. Install Fabric API
3. Put the mod into your mods folder
4. Launch Minecraft
